mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT A.DEPT_ID, B.DEPT_NM, SUM(A.TOTAL_CNT) AS TOTAL_SEND_CNT, SUM(A.SUCCESS_CNT) AS TOTAL_SUCCESS_CNT, SUM(A.FAIL_CNT) AS TOTAL_FAIL_CNT FROM TB_SMS_HISTORY A JOIN TB_DEPT B ON A.DEPT_ID = B.DEPT_ID WHERE 1=1
AND A.SEND_DT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND B.DEPT_NM LIKE '%' || #{deptNm} || '%'
GROUP BY A.DEPT_ID, B.DEPT_NM ORDER BY TOTAL_SEND_CNT DESC ) A
